FN-W1N4855-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 255
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 255 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Crime Victims
Compensation Commission by a commission-estimated $42,000 annually by extending the time
allowed for an individual to file a claim for compensation from one year after the injury or death
of an individual, under current law, to two years, as provided by this bill.
Page 1
